description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects expression-language interpolation markers in the format query argument.
affected_versions: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile: consult linked CNA affected configuration; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects expression-language interpolation markers in the format query argument.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate format strings containing literal interpolation syntax are denied.
